summary: Meshy's Free plan grants 100 credits every month for its 3D-generation tools (text-to-3D, image-to-3D, AI texturing), resetting at 00:00 UTC on the first of each month. No credit card required; free-plan outputs are licensed under CC BY 4.0.
claim_steps: Sign up free at https://www.meshy.ai — no credit card required.
Receive 100 credits/month; credits reset at 00:00 UTC on the first day of each month.
Free-plan outputs carry a CC BY 4.0 license (commercial use allowed with attribution).
